_comment_organization: Set this to your Sentry organization slug, or override it per run with SENTRY_ORG. It is not the display name.
_comment_region: The migration point between Sentry regions. A US account uses https://us.sentry.io/api/0; an EU account uses https://de.sentry.io/api/0. SENTRY_API_BASE overrides it for one run.
_comment_projects: Project slugs must match the projects the DSNs report to. The API sends to SENTRY_DSN / VITE_SENTRY_DSN; create both projects before applying this file, or the rules will reference projects that do not exist.
_comment_actions: Actions are deliberately empty. After the script applies this file, pick a notification target per rule in the Sentry UI (Settings > Alerts).
_comment_condition_result: The Sentry API requires `conditionResult` on every condition. For issue alerts it is a boolean (true fires). For metric alerts it maps to issue priority: 75 = high, 50 = low, 0 = resolved.
_comment_event_types: dataSources need `eventTypes`. Errors use ["default", "error"]. Transactions use ["trace_item_span"].
_comment_condition_group: Detectors need a top-level `conditionGroup` defining the threshold (gt/lte/anomaly_detection).
_comment_dataset: Sentry is migrating transaction-based alerts away from `dataset: transactions`. Transaction metrics use `dataset: events_analytics_platform` with `is_transaction:true` in the query.
_comment_cron: There is no scheduled-job alert here because the template ships no scheduled jobs. When you add one that calls Sentry.captureCheckIn with a stable slug, add an alert of kind `metric` with a `detector_slugs` array instead of a `detector` block — the provisioning script resolves each slug to a monitor id via GET /organizations/{org}/monitors/ and fails loudly if a monitor does not exist yet.

alerts.name: API: Error spike
alerts.description: More than 50 error events in 5 minutes. The detector is created alongside this workflow.

alerts.description: p95 of transaction.duration > 1500ms in any 10-minute window on /api/* routes.

alerts.name: Web: New issue
